chapter_title: Asking AI Well and Checking the Results
title: What to Hand to AI
description: Decide which parts of a task to delegate to AI, which to keep, and where you keep the final decision.
learning_objectives: Separate a task into parts you can delegate and parts that are the point of the learning.
Explain why delegating the thinking a course is meant to build can undermine learning.
Keep responsibility for the final decision and the final work.
